objective: Build a hardware-feature-matched INT8 baseline with frozen scales, traceable export and an operational plateau check; improvement and convergence are not guaranteed.

data.feature: Existing deployment mirror only, 21 dimensions, unchanged historical K7 and GT tracks
data.test_use: No new historical-test evaluation or selection

training.loss: Class-weighted cross entropy, weights fitted to full train only
training.checkpoint_rule: Final epoch at predeclared training-only plateau or hard limit; no best-validation selection
training.calibration: Train-only deterministic sample, 99.99th percentile of nonnegative activations and max-absolute weights; freeze all scales before QAT
training.normalization: Train mean/std in FP32 warmup; algebraically fold into layer 1 before quantization, no runtime standardization
training.qat_arithmetic: INT8 weights/hidden activations, INT32 bias/accumulator, fixed multiplier and shift=16, ties-to-even; exact integer forward represented in float64 with STE backward
training.candidates: One protocol and two seeds; no architecture or representation search

plateau.monitor: Deterministic train calibration-subset loss at epoch end
plateau.validation_reporting: Validation F1 is logged but does not stop or select a checkpoint; last-five F1 span <=0.003 is reported separately
plateau.meaning: Operational loss plateau only, not a global optimum, independent generalization proof or cross-seed equivalence

gates: Python synthetic folding/rounding/integer checks before full preparation or training
Recovered full-train features/labels and previous subset must agree
FP32 fold tolerance, finite losses and integer range checks
Full-validation hidden activations and logits must match Torch/NumPy/old C inference body with new isolated header
Frozen evaluation must be invariant to batch partition and sample order
Stop on mismatch, timeout or fixed two-seed budget; retain negative results

limitations: Validation has already been used in research; no independent untouched test is available in this task
Historical K7 and GT-track assumptions are unchanged
A new parameter package does not update the original bitstream or prove FPGA timing
A numerical plateau need not imply useful classification quality
